authoring: Manual source reading + independent stem/branch domain enumeration; no production resolver, scorer, presence evaluator, or calendar output used. Unknown results are intentional, not blanket day classifications.
limitations: 720 contexts enumerate the domain and explicitly have no global-grade/score oracle yet. They are not 720 successful score validations.
Source-role map is not a hierarchy. Bare 德 predicate and global precedence unresolved.
Local monthly grades do not resolve pillar-specific overrides or the 月害 寅月 companion conflict.
Warehouse cases cover 收日 co-presence subset; full source-clause activity Golden still required.
